result.instructions: Tools for SugarWOD, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Who are the athletes at our gym who are coaches?"; "What workouts are scheduled on our Workout of the Day track this week?"; "Which athletes logged a score for yesterday's workout?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes SugarWOD data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run sugarwod_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run sugarwod_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run sugarwod_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. sugarwod_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: sugarwod_get_box
tools.title: Get the gym
tools.description: Get the gym (SugarWOD calls it the affiliate or box) this API key belongs to: name, address and logo. Good first call to confirm the key works. SugarWOD API: GET /v2/box.

tools.name: sugarwod_get_account_owner
tools.title: Get the account owner
tools.description: Get the athlete who is the registered owner of the gym's SugarWOD account. SugarWOD API: GET /v2/box/account-owner.

tools.name: sugarwod_list_athletes
tools.title: List athletes
tools.description: List the gym's athletes, coaches and owners, one page at a time. Filter with role. Use skip and limit to page through the list. SugarWOD API: GET /v2/athletes.

skip.description: Number of items to skip (paging offset, default 0).

tools.name: sugarwod_get_athlete
tools.title: Get an athlete
tools.description: Get one athlete of the gym by id: name, email, gender, coach or owner flags and last login. SugarWOD API: GET /v2/athletes/{athlete_id}.

athlete_id.description: The athlete id (from another SugarWOD tool).

tools.name: sugarwod_find_athlete_by_email
tools.title: Find an athlete by email
tools.description: Find the gym's athlete who registered with this email address. SugarWOD API: GET /v2/athletes/find?email=.

email.description: The email address the athlete registered with.

tools.name: sugarwod_update_athlete
tools.title: Update an athlete
tools.description: Change an athlete's first name, last name or email in the gym's SugarWOD. Give at least one field. Only these three fields can be changed through the API. Changes the live gym record; the same values give the same result on a repeat call. SugarWOD API: PATCH /v2/athletes/{athlete_id}.

athlete_id.description: The athlete id (from another SugarWOD tool).

tools.name: sugarwod_list_tracks
tools.title: List tracks
tools.description: List the gym's tracks: the calendars of workouts for groups, such as Workout of the Day or a barbell club. Use a track id with sugarwod_list_workouts. Pages of 25 by default; links.next in the reply gives the next page. SugarWOD API: GET /v2/tracks.

skip.description: Number of items to skip (paging offset, default 0).

tools.name: sugarwod_list_workouts
tools.title: List workouts
tools.description: List the gym's workouts for one date or a date range (7 days at most), optionally for one track. Workouts are scheduled by date, not by class time. Pages of 25 by default; links.next in the reply gives the next page. SugarWOD API: GET /v2/workouts?dates=&track_id=.

dates.description: One date (YYYYMMDD) or a range (YYYYMMDD-YYYYMMDD, 7 days at most). Default: today in UTC.

track_id.description: Only workouts on this track (from sugarwod_list_tracks).

skip.description: Number of items to skip (paging offset, default 0).

tools.name: sugarwod_get_workout
tools.title: Get a workout
tools.description: Get one scheduled workout by id: title, description, score type, date, track and movements. SugarWOD API: GET /v2/workouts/{workout_id}.

workout_id.description: The workout id (from another SugarWOD tool).

tools.name: sugarwod_list_workout_athletes
tools.title: List athletes who logged a workout
tools.description: List the athletes who logged a score for one workout. Pages of 25 by default; links.next in the reply gives the next page. SugarWOD API: GET /v2/workouts/{workout_id}/athletes.

workout_id.description: The workout id (from another SugarWOD tool).

skip.description: Number of items to skip (paging offset, default 0).

annotations.title: List athletes who logged a workout

tools.name: sugarwod_list_benchmarks_by_category
tools.title: List benchmark workouts
tools.description: List the SugarWOD library's benchmark workouts in one category (Girls, Heroes, Games, gymnastics, notable or custom). SugarWOD API: GET /v2/benchmarks/category/{category}.

skip.description: Number of items to skip (paging offset, default 0).

tools.name: sugarwod_get_benchmark
tools.title: Get a benchmark workout
tools.description: Get one benchmark workout by id: title, description, score type, category and movements. SugarWOD API: GET /v2/benchmarks/{benchmark_id}.

benchmark_id.description: The benchmark id (from another SugarWOD tool).

tools.name: sugarwod_list_movements
tools.title: List movements
tools.description: List movements in the SugarWOD library (for example Box Jump, Back Squat, Wall Ball). Pages of 25 by default; links.next in the reply gives the next page. SugarWOD API: GET /v2/movements.

skip.description: Number of items to skip (paging offset, default 0).

tools.name: sugarwod_get_movement
tools.title: Get a movement
tools.description: Get one movement by id: name and its videos. SugarWOD API: GET /v2/movements/{movement_id}.

movement_id.description: The movement id (from another SugarWOD tool).

tools.name: sugarwod_get_barbell_lift
tools.title: Get a barbell lift
tools.description: Get one barbell lift by id (for example Back Squat or Hang Power Clean): name, category and its movements. SugarWOD API: GET /v2/barbelllifts/{barbelllift_id}.

barbelllift_id.description: The barbell lift id (from another SugarWOD tool).
